[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Ah! [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!
Nice timing!\c
You caught most of that, right?
What d’you say? You wanna come with me?
Th-thanks, pal! It’ll be a big relief to have you!\nI’ll just let you lead the way, OK?
Right...\nThen I’ll just wait till you say you’re ready!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Ready when you are!\c\nI’ll be right behind you, so don’t worry.\nI’ve got your back.
